title: Sharpness conjecture for the radio-k-number of even cycles
source: Colin Bloomfield, Daphne Der-Fen Liu and Jeannette Ramirez, “Radio-k-Labeling of Cycles for Large k”, arXiv:2106.15059 (v2, 2022), Conjecture 1; Discrete Applied Mathematics (2022), doi 10.1016/j.dam.2022.03.020. (https://arxiv.org/abs/2106.15059)
statement:
Let $n$ be even and $k$ be odd with

$$
\frac{n}{2} \leqslant k < n-3.
$$

Set

$$
h=\frac{n-k-1}{2},\qquad p=\gcd(n,h).
$$

Write $\langle h\rangle$ for the subgroup generated by $h$ in the relevant cyclic group. **Sharpness conjecture.** If $n/2\in\langle h\rangle$, then

$$
\operatorname{rn}_k(C_n)=\operatorname{LB}(n,k)+p-1.
$$

The paper notes that the values of the radio $k$-number are known for most parameters in the stated range, but cases with different parities remain open. The conjecture asserts that the upper bound from the preceding theorem is sharp whenever $n/2\in\langle h\rangle$.
summary: For every even n and odd k with n/2 <= k < n-3, with h = (n-k-1)/2 and p = gcd(n,h), if n/2 lies in the subgroup of Z_n generated by h then the radio-k-number of the cycle C_n equals LB(n,k) + p - 1. This is Conjecture 1 of Bloomfield, Liu and Ramirez. The upper bound is the source's Theorem 11; the new part is the matching lower bound, where the source proves only LB + ceil(p/2) - 1. The proof makes the source's gap lemma quantitative, maps vertices to residues modulo p, and rules out the case where the resulting closed walk wraps around, which is exactly the factor of two the source left open. Lean states the conjecture literally: the graph distance of Mathlib's cycle graph, the radio inequality over the integers, the radio-k-number as a minimum span, and LB proved equal to the source's formula.
paste_summary: Proved. For even n and odd k with n/2 <= k < n-3, h = (n-k-1)/2 and p = gcd(n,h), if n/2 lies in the subgroup generated by h then rn_k(C_n) = LB(n,k) + p - 1. This is Conjecture 1 of Bloomfield, Liu and Ramirez (arXiv:2106.15059): the upper bound of their Theorem 11 is sharp.
caveat: Bounded literature search only. The publisher refused the journal text; the journal abstract is word for word the arXiv one and arXiv v2 thanks the referees and was posted in the month of acceptance, so it is taken as the accepted version, but the typeset article was not read. A specialist could regard the proof as a careful refinement of the source's own lower-bound method (cross-model confidence 0.75). A related closed-walk idea appears in Campbell, arXiv:2609.29477, for a different conjecture.
